page.layout: One printed page: a heading centred at the top, then two parallel tables side by side separated by a double rule. Left table columns: Cap., Verf., Pag. Right table columns: Cap., Verf., Pag. No margin notes, no page number, no catchword.

main_text.head: Locorum Scriptura.
main_text.l: Cap. | Verf. | Pag. || Cap. | Verf. | Pag.

page.notes: Table is set in two parallel columns; the cells are shown with " | " separators as instructed. Some numerals are uncertain in the scan (e.g. "1140", "1072", "1164"), but copied as they appear. Right-hand column of the first two rows of the left table has no Cap. entry on the lower lines. The final line "Oooo / Pag." is a printed signature-like mark, transcribed as printed.
